{{See also|Kindlebane Dagger}} {{Infobox/Weapon |rarity = e |slayer_level_requirement = Blaze Slayer 4 |damage = +130 |strength = +55 |crit_damage = +20% |attack_speed = +10% |upgrades_from = Twilight Dagger |upgrades_to = Deathripper Dagger |enchantable = y |reforgeable = y |auctionable = y |museum = y |museum_xp = 10 |museum_category = combat |raw_materials = *26400 Sulphur *1152 Derelict Ashe *5760 Red Sand *5760 Mycelium *23040 Magma Cream *23040 Glowstone Dust *23040 Nether Wart *23040 Blaze Rod *1 Stick |bazaar_not_including = [[Stick]] |mat_cost_bazaar = *1 Enchanted Sulphur Cube *5 Enchanted Sulphur *9 MOLTEN_POWDER |raw_materials_upgr =*25600 Sulphur *1024 Derelict Ashe *5120 Red Sand *5120 Mycelium *20480 Magma Cream *20480 Glowstone Dust *20480 Nether Wart *20480 Blaze Rod |mat_cost_bazaar_upgr =*1 Enchanted Sulphur Cube *8 Molten Powder |id = BURSTMAW_DAGGER }} The '''Mawdredge Dagger''' is an {{Epic}} [[Sword]]. It is unlocked at {{Coll|Blaze Slayer IV}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Blaze Slayer 4}} |A1 = |B1 = Enchanted Sulphur Cube |C1 = |A2 = |B2 = Molten Powder, 8 |C2 = |A3 = |B3 = Twilight Dagger |C3 = |Output = Mawdredge Dagger }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |name = Mawdredge Dagger |rarity = e |damage = 130 |attack_speed = 10 |crit_damage = 20 |strength = 55 |special_effect = Deal {{Red|2.5x}} damage to {{mt|Infernal}} mobs.
Deal {{Red|1.5x}} damage to {{mt|Skeletal}} mobs.
Gain {{stat|combat wisdom|+30}} against {{mt|Infernal}} mobs. |item_ability_name = Attunement |item_ability_description = Swap between {{White|Spirit}} and {{Cyan|Crystal}} mode in order to attack through Hellion Shields. |item_ability_activation = On Right Click |item_ability_name2 = Wraith Drain |item_ability_description2 = On hit, heal for {{Red|200}} + {{Red|4%}}{{HP}} after {{Green|6s}} if the Hellion Shield has switched attunement. }} The '''Mawdredge Dagger''' deals {{Red|2.5x}} damage to {{mt|Infernal}} mobs and {{Red|1.5x}} damage to {{mt|Skeletal}} mobs. Additionally, it provides {{Stat|combat wisdom|+30}} against {{mt|Infernal}} mobs. The '''Mawdredge Dagger''' has {{Green|2}} abilities: * {{AN|Attunement}} allows the wielder to swap between '''Spirit''' and {{Aqua|'''Crystal'''}} attunements in order to attack through the {{MobSprite|Inferno Demonlord}}'s {{AN|Hellion Shield}} ability. When switching attunement, the '''Mawdredge Dagger''' changes appearance from a {{Item|Iron Sword|link=}} to a {{Item|Golden Sword|link=}}. * {{AN|Wraith Drain}} allows the wielder to heal {{Stat|hp|200}} + {{Stat|hp|4%|icononly=yes}} after {{Green|6s}} upon hit if the {{AN|Hellion Shield}} has switched attunement. === Crafting === {{Crafting Usage}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/Mar 21|link=none|[[File:Mawdredge Dagger (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Mawdredge Dagger'''.}} {{History|2024/Nov 25|link=none|'''Mawdredge Dagger''' now grants {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+30}} against Blazes.}} {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Mawdredge Dagger (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Mawdredge Dagger''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Mawdredge Dagger (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Mawdredge Dagger'''.|'''Mawdredge Dagger''' now grants {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+30}} against Blazes.}} {{History|0.23.3|'''Mawdredge Dagger''' perks changed to affect {{mt|Infernal}} and {{mt|Wither}} mobs.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Mawdredge Dagger (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Mawdredge Dagger''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Blaze}} [[Category:Daggers]]
